# CEP Endfield Planner

> Free planner suite for Arknights: Endfield — essence farming, equipment refinement, growth planning, banner calendar, stats preview, and game-data wiki.

CEP (Cep Endfield Planner). Default locale is `zh-CN`; also available in `zh-TW`, `ja`, and `en`.
Official site: https://end.canmoe.com
This project is unofficial fan work and is not affiliated with Hypergryph / Mountain Contour.
Frontend source: https://github.com/cmyyx/cep (AGPL-3.0).
Generated at: 2026-08-17T17:54:38.295Z

## Core tools

- [Home](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN): CEP Endfield Planner landing page and module overview
- [Essence Planner](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/essence-planner): Multi-weapon essence farming optimization with lock constraints, attribute conflict resolution, and ranked plans
- [Refinement Planner](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/refinement-planner): Equipment refinement planning — materials and substat optimization
- [Growth Planner](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/growth-planner): Operator and weapon growth planner for levels, skills, promotions, breakthroughs, and stamina
- [Stats Preview](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/panel-preview): Operator stats preview with configurable operators, equipment, weapons, and full panel attributes
- [Banner Calendar](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/banner-calendar): Gacha banner schedule, rerun timeline, and pull planning
- [Background Preview](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/background-preview): Preview and select website background artwork

## Wiki

- [Characters Wiki](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/wiki/characters): Operator list with filters; detail pages for every character
- [Weapons Wiki](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/wiki/weapons): Weapon list with filters; detail pages for every weapon
- [Equipment Wiki](https://end.canmoe.com/zh-CN/wiki/equipment): Equipment list with filters; detail pages for every gear piece

Wiki detail pages for every character, weapon, and equipment are listed in [llms-full.txt](https://end.canmoe.com/llms-full.txt).
